5331.description: Increases its Attack Bar by 30% whenever the enemy's turn ends. [Automatic Effect]
5331.name: Raging Whirlwind (Passive)

5332.description: Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects and grant Oblivion for 1 turn.
5332.name: Nebeladora

5333.description: Attacks the enemy with the highest Attack Bar 3 times, dealing damage that ignores Defense based on the difference in Attack Speed between the boss and the target, and decreasing its Attack Bar by 30% on each hit.
5333.name: Aggressive Assault

5334.description: Whenever its turn ends, decreases the Attack Speed of all enemies for 2 turns with a 50% chance. [Automatic Effect]
5334.name: Magic Fog (Passive)

5335.description: Attacks taken from enemies with lower Attack Speed than the boss always land as a Glancing Hit. [Automatic Effect]
5335.name: Sensory Disruption (Passive)

5336.description: Attacks all enemies 4 times. The first hit removes 1 beneficial effect with a 75% chance, the second hit decreases their Defense for 2 turns with a 75% chance, the third hit grants Seal for 2 turns with a 75% chance, and the fourth hit disturbs HP recovery for 2 turns with a 75% chance.
5336.name: Quadruple Slash

5337.description: Attacks the enemy 7 times. First to sixth hits remove 1 beneficial effect with a 20% chance and stun for 1 turn with a 20% chance. The last hit deals damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.
5337.name: Swordplay Onslaught

5338.description: Attacks the enemy to instantly defeat the target. This skill can be used when the boss has no weapons.
5338.name: Final Counter

5339.description: Whenever the boss loses 20% HP, one of its weapons breaks. When its weapon breaks, the boss gains a turn, and its Attack Power and Attack Speed increase by 20%. [Automatic Effect]
5339.name: Expert Swordsman (Passive)

5340.description: At the start of its turn, the ally with the best HP condition goes under the Threat state while enemies attack with a single-target skill 1 time. [Automatic Effect]
5340.name: Tactical Assessment (Passive)
